messages:
maria: Heads-up: found a bunch of 404s from recent sneakpeek redirect change in the runtime guide. Quick scan shows anchors like `/runtime#kv-cache` are 404ing on staging. Pinging docs squad — who can own a tiny hotfix? https://redwood-inference.internal/docs/runtime/sneakpeek

sam: Thanks, Maria. Can you paste the failing markdown line or the exact anchor id? Is this a frontmatter permalink change or an anchor mismatch?

maria: The anchor lines look like this in the markdown:

```markdown
- [KV cache tuning](#kv-cache)
```

but the heading is rendered as `KV cache tuning (runtime)` which makes the anchor `kv-cache-tuning-runtime` after the mdx processor. Quick local sed that fixes the link targets for the file:

```bash
# in repo root
sed -i "s/#kv-cache)/#kv-cache-tuning-runtime)/g" docs/runtime/sneakpeek.md
```

sam: ok good to know. If it's just the displayed heading change we can patch links. Also watch out for CDN staging TTL — last time fixes didn't show immediately.

kai: I can take the PR. small sed + preview, should be quick. @sam can you review? :thumbsup:

sam: I can review EOD. Please run the local linkcheck before merging. Also @docs-bot any scan notes?

docs-bot: Auto-scan completed: 7 orphan anchors detected under `/runtime/sneakpeek`. Severity: low. Suggested: normalize heading text or update internal links. See scan id `scan-2026-04-03-7`.

maria: Thanks! Kai, when you open the PR include checklist:
- run `npx markdown-link-check docs/runtime/sneakpeek.md`
- add a 1-line changelog in the docs-corrections section
- add @sam as reviewer
Also confirm no canonical slug changes so eng-infra redirect ticket not needed. :coffee:

kai: Will open in ~30m. PR branch `fix/sneakpeek-anchors-1711114444`. I'll paste the `markdown-link-check` output in the PR description.

docs-bot: Note: if changes affect canonical slugs or permalinks please open a redirect request in #eng-infra. Otherwise no infra action required.

maria: Confirmed: no canonical/permalink changes, just anchor id mismatch. Thanks all — looping back once PR lands. :eyes:
